name: agent-toolkit
description: Personal agent toolkit: reusable development workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Agent workflows for software development and codebase research.
interface.longDescription: Covers development building blocks: requirement grilling, specs and tickets, TDD red-green loops, two-axis code review, bug diagnosis, workspace isolation, and branch wrap-up. Also includes standalone tools for codebase research, first-party source research, prototyping, blind skill testing, and config sync.
defaultPrompt: Research the current codebase and give me a structured report.
Grill this idea thoroughly, then produce a spec and a set of tickets.
Implement the feature from this spec and commit it.
